meta.name: orchestration
meta.description: Coordinate supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates, coordinator loops, and decomposing work across agents. Use `orca-cli` for full ownership handoffs — "hand off", "handoff", "handover", "give this to another agent", "another worktree" — unless asked to supervise, monitor, or coordinate a DAG, and for terminal control, lightweight terminal prompts, shell commands, Orca worktree management, and reading or waiting on terminals. Use Computer Use for external browser windows, webviews, Orca app UI, or desktop UI outside Orca's embedded browser only when the task requires OS/window-level control such as focus, menus, dialogs, coordinates, or screenshots. Use `orca-cli` for Orca's embedded pages and a page-automation tool such as Playwright or CDP for external pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 统筹多个 AI 工人,分步交接并监督任务执行进度。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望把复杂任务拆给多个 AI 工人,并保持过程可控可见。
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate several AI workers to split tasks and oversee step-by-step progress.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage several AI assistants and want visible, controlled delegation across them.

howto.what: 让 Claude 协调多个受监督的 Orca worker：收发线程消息、阻塞式问答、派发任务、等待完成或升级、编排任务 DAG 与决策门，并拆分工作给不同 agent。运行前先解析本会话的 CLI，再加载版本匹配的指南。
howto.when: 当你需要结构化多 agent 协调时接管，如线程消息、任务派发、任务 DAG 等；若只是移交所有权（“hand off”）或普通终端控制则改用 orca-cli 技能。

say.text: 帮我给这个任务建一条任务 DAG，拆分给几个 worker 并行做。
say.note: 会派发任务并等待各 worker 完成。

say.text: 问一下那个 worktree 里的 worker 现在进展如何，等它回复。
say.note: 用阻塞式 ask/reply 等待回复。

say.text: 把这几步编排成带决策门的协调循环，依次监督执行。
say.note: 进入协调循环，在决策门处暂停。

howto.what_en: Claude coordinates supervised Orca workers: threaded messages, blocking ask/reply, task dispatch, worker_done/escalation waits, task DAGs, decision gates and coordinator loops, splitting work across agents. It first resolves the session CLI, then loads the version-matched guide.
howto.when_en: Engages when you need structured multi-agent coordination: threaded messages, task dispatch, task DAGs, etc. For ownership handoffs ("hand off") or plain terminal control, use the orca-cli skill.

say_en.text: Build a task DAG for this work and split it across several workers.
say_en.note: Dispatches tasks and waits for workers to finish.

say_en.text: Ask the worker in that worktree for a status update and wait for its reply.
say_en.note: Uses blocking ask/reply to wait for the response.

say_en.text: Orchestrate these steps as a coordinator loop with a decision gate.
say_en.note: Runs the loop and pauses at the decision gate.
